snippet.title: Marfusha Animation Opening MV
snippet.description:
Marfusha
PLAYISM Page: https://playism.com/en/game/marfusha/
Nintendo eShop: https://www.nintendo.com/store/products/Marfusha-switch/
PlayStation Store (PS4): https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/UP0969-CUSA35580_00-00000000MARFUSHA
PlayStation Store (PS5): https://store.playstation.com/en-us/product/UP0969-PPSA09593_00-00000000MARFUSHA
Microsoft Store: https://www.xbox.com/en-us/games/store/7d8934b9/9NVFCCC73JC1

Marfusha is an indie game developed by Japanese illustrator hinyari9.

You control the titular main character Marfusha, who has been conscripted into the army to defend her country's borders in a fictional, war-ravaged dystopian world. 

This is a high-speed tower defense shooter, where you have to shoot down all the enemy machines before they break through the gates.

Theme Song "I'll be there"
Music, Lyrics, Vocals: KOKIA
Arrangement: Takahito Eguchi

Opening Animation
Director: MAEDA Chisei (Chisey)
Compositor: TOHRU MiTSUHASHi
